title: Two-step query-state simulation
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be a Boolean oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration on Boolean input $x$ whose state is the query state of $N$. Suppose an added tape has content $T$, head position $p$, and scanned symbol $b$, so that $T(p)=b$. After two steps, the constructed deterministic oracle machine reaches the configuration obtained by taking one nondeterministic step of $N$ on $c$ using choice bit $b$ and adding the same tape with its head at $p+1$.
hypotheses_covered: finite nondeterministic oracle machine N over Bool
c is in N's query state
added tape content T and head position p
b is the Boolean symbol stored at p
